title: HtmlCanvas
responsibility: Renders the native canvas element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlCanvas.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet that the component invokes and renders inside the canvas when present. If omitted, no snippet content is rendered, and the component does not transform the snippet.

outputs.name: HtmlCanvas
outputs.description: A native canvas element with all props other than children spread onto it, and the snippet rendered inside when supplied. The element is returned directly without a wrapper.
